title: nesogordonia fouassieri
intro: Nesogordonia fouassieri, commonly known as African mangrove, is a plant species native to West and Central Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions like fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Nesogordonia fouassieri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
